# aibris v0.11.1

This patch publishes the Homebrew tap as the recommended macOS install and
installs shell completions plus man pages into the Homebrew prefix.

## Highlights

- macOS install is now `brew install sungjunlee/tap/aibris` from the
  third-party tap `sungjunlee/homebrew-tap`. `install.sh` remains the
  checksummed Homebrew-free path with default `~/.local/bin`.
- The Formula installs bash, zsh, and fish completions from the poured
  binary and copies man pages from the release archive into the Homebrew
  prefix.
- zsh completions appear on `fpath` after Homebrew's standard
  `eval "$(brew shellenv)"`. Stock macOS zsh without that setup does not
  include `/opt/homebrew/share/zsh/site-functions`.

## Compatibility impact

**Compatible addition.** Documented CLI flags, JSON fields, defaults, and
exit behavior are unchanged. The new surface is the Homebrew formula and
its prefix-installed completions/man pages.

## Upgrade and migration

```bash
brew install sungjunlee/tap/aibris
# already installed from the tap:
brew upgrade aibris
```

No CLI migration is required. `install.sh` users can keep that path.

## Windows status

Windows archives are **experimental**. The supported shape is the `amd64` /
`arm64` Windows zip archives cross-built by GoReleaser and listed in
`checksums.txt`. Native users verify the SHA-256 and place `aibris.exe` on
`PATH`; `install.sh` remains Unix-only. Pull-request CI builds and exercises
the native executable (`--version`, `--help`, isolated `scan --json`), home /
cache isolation, recorded-cwd volume safety, reparse-point cleanup
protection, and hermetic HOME fixture behavior on `windows-latest`. A
Windows version matrix is not published.

## Verification

Pre-tag verification passed `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, and
`go test ./...`. The curated-release Windows-status validator must pass on
this file. The tagged release workflow publishes the six Darwin/Linux/Windows
archives, `checksums.txt`, and the tap Formula update.
